shared_elements: figural relief carved on a tall upright stone face
creature/being rendered in raised relief against a plain-ish ground
vertical stacking of two figural motifs, one above the other
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry figural relief on a tall upright stone face with motifs stacked vertically. What is actually depicted differs entirely — A shows sparse, isolated quadruped/reptilian animals in profile with clean uninterrupted ground, while B shows a frontal costumed human figure with headdress, pectoral and a subsidiary masked figure below, embedded in dense all-over scrollwork ornament.
